resources.string: At least %1$d characters. Keep it in a password manager or write it down: nobody, not even your admins, can read it back to you.
Your account is already set up on another device. Link this phone from it: it\'s quickest, and your message history comes along.
No other device at hand? Enter your recovery passphrase.
On your other phone: open TeamCraft, Settings → Devices → Link a device, and scan this code.
On a computer: Settings → Devices and security → Link a new device, and enter this code.
Allow notifications to hear about direct messages, mentions and calls while TeamCraft is closed. Message content stays encrypted until it reaches this phone.
People you share a channel with appear here. Join a channel first, or ask a colleague to add you to one.
Nobody has created a channel you can join here yet. Create one with New channel.
You aren\'t in a space yet. Ask your admin to add you to one.
